CV: "Full-cycle deal closing: prospecting, qualifying leads, and closing deals across 180+ new business and commercial contracts from discovery to signature."
CV: "Daily CRM user with Salesforce and HubSpot for pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, activity logging, and maintaining complete account records."
CV: "Led commercial terms negotiation, pricing proposals, and boardroom presentations to senior stakeholders and decision-makers."
CV: "Managed long-term client relationship and account management portfolios with 96% retention, consistent upselling and renewals, and fluent bilingual communication in English and French."

strengths: 6 years of B2B and retail sales experience consistently exceeding quotas by 125%
Strong track record of closing 180+ commercial and business contracts full-cycle
Daily hands-on proficiency with both Salesforce and HubSpot CRM
Demonstrated 96% client retention with upselling and fluent bilingual communication in English and French
reasoning: Candidate C001 strongly exceeds all must-have and nice-to-have criteria with 6 years of B2B and retail sales experience, 180+ closed deals, and daily Salesforce and HubSpot proficiency. Measurable achievements such as 125% target attainment and 96% client retention make this a clear shortlist recommendation.
